behaviors.behavior: AC9: a codex task's new-pipeline launch is blocked, keyed on actionId (not phase — a phase-only submission never blocks); a claude task's new-pipeline launch is unaffected

surface_verification.justification: This diff touches API routes (PATCH runtime, launch chokepoint), store mutations (task.runtime persistence, boardColumn sync on auto-completion) and Inbox feeds — the Backend-affects-Frontend rule fires unconditionally. The E2E spec proves the one journey unit tests can't: a real browser round-trip through NewTaskModal -> RuntimeToggle -> persisted task.runtime='codex' -> Edit dialog reflecting it pre-launch, and the runtime field freezing read-only after a genuine POST /launch call against the real running stack (client/e2e/isolated-stack.mjs). A real Codex launch is not exercised in E2E because AC8's codex_cli_not_found gate correctly 400s on any machine without the Codex CLI on PATH (a real, correct product gate) — that path is covered by runtime-chokepoint.test.ts instead.
